stem: A movement order expects 48 plants, but the physical count is 47. What should the technician do?
choices: Enter 48 because the order is authoritative
Add an unrelated plant to make the count match
Verify the physical count and report/reconcile the discrepancy under procedure before finalizing the movement
Change the work order to 47 without explanation
rationale: Physical-versus-record differences must be reconciled honestly rather than forced to match.
